messages:
sam: FYI customer reported what looks like duplicate streaming charges after a reconnect that happened while a toolcall was inflight. small repro below. filing here to decide mitigation.
liam: can you paste the logs + whether the client used any resume token?
sam: sanitized timeline:
```
[09:21:05] session=Z1 start stream -> emitted 120 tokens (prefix P)
[09:21:07] runtime issues TOOLCALL (wait for response)
[09:21:08] client network blip, reconnect -> new session=Z1b, resume attempted
[09:21:09] server replays prefix P -> emits 120 tokens (duplicate)
[09:21:10] ledger: STREAM_CONFIRMED Z1 tokens=120
[09:21:11] ledger: TOOLCALL_CONFIRMED Z1 tokens=30
[09:21:12] ledger: STREAM_CONFIRMED Z1b tokens=120
```
net: billed 120+30+120 instead of 120+30.
sofia: hmm. pattern looks like the router/runtime accepted a resume that created a new session id rather than binding to original. our billing dedupe is session-id based, so it double-counted.
liam: quick mitigation idea: add a server-side short-lived mapping from client_resume_token->canonical_session. when resume arrives, normalize to canonical session id before emitting billing events. this buys us immediate protection without client SDK changes. low risk if TTL is short.
sam: sounds promising. any concerns about spoofing client_resume_token?
sofia: we could require resume tokens be HMAC(client_token || timestamp) signed by the SDK with a per-tenant key, or server can HMAC-verify if client uses SDK helper. for compatibility, server-side mapping can only be used for verified tokens; unverified resumes fall through to old behavior and get flagged in the UI.
liam: billing-bot 1: can we query how often we see two confirmed streams within 15s with >60% prefix overlap and different session ids? also sum tokens involved.
billing-bot: quick sample query result: last 7d -> suspect duplicate stream pairs: 84 orgs, 472 pairs, total extra tokens ~ 89,300. top affected org has ~12k extra tokens.
sam: okay that's actionable. let's do a two-track plan: short-term server-side resume canonicalization for verified tokens + console flag and manual refund workflow; mid-term: SDKs emit signed stitch_token and we document TLS/HMAC approach; long-term: full billing pipeline dedupe using stitch_id and prefix similarity.
sofia: console UX: mark sessions as "possible duplicate resume" and allow ops to merge sessions or request automatic refund. show the two session rows collapsed with token deltas and a link to open billing dispute. keep an audit trail.
liam: note on quotas: we should NOT deduct quota refunds automatically because enforcement decisions made earlier shouldn't be silently reverted. instead show a refund credit applied to billing and a separate quota adjustment policy (manual or delayed rollback subject to admin). we should document clearly.
sofia: also edge-case: toolcalls that return trimmed prefix could reduce measured overlap; add a fallback to compare suffix k-gram of last 32 tokens or fingerprint last N bytes. that will increase detection coverage. track false positives metric.
billing-bot: posting proposed metric names: duplicate_stream_pair_count, duplicate_stream_extra_tokens, duplicate_stream_false_positive_rate.
ops-bot: suggestion: feature-flag the canonicalization and enable for 5% of traffic in canary orgs then 25% after 24h if no regressions. also add an alert if duplicate_stream_extra_tokens > 5000 in 1h for a single org.
sam: i'll open INF-2189 with logs and owner list. liam/sofia please take infra + UI. i'll coordinate billing follow-up. thanks. :thumbsup:
liam: opened INF-2189, assigned @liam @sofia @sam. added reproduction logs.
sofia: i'll sketch a small console mock and add the audit fields (stitch_verified, resume_token_hash) to session timeline.
liam: dev plan:
- week1: implement server-side resume canonicalization for verified tokens (TTL=10s), unit tests, feature flag.
- week2: add telemetry panels and alert, enable 5% canary.
- week3: SDK work + docs + billing pipeline dedupe RFC.
sofia: sounds good. follow-ups: compliance wants that any automatic canonicalization is logged (stitch verification + action). i added a note to the ticket.
sam: great. closing thread after ticket created.
